title: DSTP003
content:
[vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Job Role – Field worker"]
  1. Qualifications – Graduate in any discipline
  2. Experience – 2-3 years of experience in social sector/ Education / Livelihood
  3. Location – Mysore
  4. Vacancies – 01
  5. Salary – 18,000/+HRA
  Role and Responsibilities
  • Maintain a neat and professional appearance and provide hospitality for the beneficiary Secures premises and Monitoring surveillance equipment, inspecting buildings, equipment, and access points; permitting entry.
  • Completes reports by recording observations, information, occurrences, and surveillance activities; interviewing witnesses; obtaining signatures.
  • Duties assigned by the PI, Co-PI, Project coordinator and Project Assistant to be completed as per the timeline and should be available in the campus on duty hours
  Basic Qualifications & Competencies
  • Graduate in any discipline
  • 2-3 years of experience in social sector/ Education / Livelihood
  • Ability to work independently & collaboratively with internal & external Stakeholders
  • Excellent written & verbal skills (in Kannada, English is desirable and in Hindi is preferable)
[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row]
